examples.prompt: Please tell me a story with Tim in it.
examples.reply:
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside. One day, he found a big, red ball. He was very happy.
Tim wanted to play with the ball, but it was difficult to reach. He tried and tried, but he could not get it. Tim was sad. He wanted to play with the ball so much.
Then, Tim had an idea. He found a long stick and used it to get the ball. He was very happy. Tim played with the ball all day long. And they lived happily ever after.

examples.prompt: Please tell me a story with Zara in it.
examples.reply:
Once upon a time, there was a zebra named Zara. Zara was a very good zebra. She liked to help her friends. One day, Zara saw her friend, a little bird named Billy, who was sad.
"Why are you sad, Billy?" asked Zara. Billy said, "I lost my nest. I can't find it." Zara wanted to help her friend. She had an idea. "I will lend you my nest," she said.
Zara and Billy went to find the nest. They looked high and low. They found the nest in a big tree. Billy was happy. "Thank you, Zara!" he said. Zara felt good because she helped her friend.
From that day on, Zara and Billy were best friends. They played together every day. Zara always helped Billy find his nest. And they lived happily ever after.
